d:
Stand-up comedian Yash Maheshwari is facing backlash over an alleged obscene joke about Bihar's women and their sindoor. A video from his Delhi-NCR comedy show has gone viral, triggering outrage on social media. Several users have demanded an FIR and strict legal action against him. BJP leader Ritu Jaiswal has also condemned the remarks, saying that insulting Chhath Puja and the faith of Chhath devotees will not be tolerated. Here's what happened and why the comedian is facing criticism.
